topic: A neighbor wants to install a fence
text: You step into my office, eyes flickering with something you’re tryin' to keep under wraps. Neighbor wants to put up a fence, huh? Well, fences make good neighbors, or so they say. But there’s always a story behind the stories, a reason why that fence is really goin' up. I’ve heard it all before—the creeping sense of invasion, the whispers of new arrivals, the subtle shift in the neighborhood. So, I lean back in my creaky chair, fingers laced together, and I watch you. Tell me about this fence. What’s really on the other side?
